about.captainBio: With over 20 years of experience fishing in Amvrakikos Bay, Captain Nikos knows all the best spots and techniques to ensure you have an unforgettable experience.
about.boatSpecs: Our fully equipped fishing vessel is designed for comfort and safety, featuring modern navigation equipment and plenty of space for up to 6 guests.
about.safetyDesc: Your safety is our priority. We maintain the highest safety standards with certified equipment and regular inspections.
about.experienceDesc: We've hosted thousands of guests from around the world and pride ourselves on creating memorable fishing adventures.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our fishing trips
faq.q1: What should I bring on the fishing trip?
faq.a1: We recommend bringing sunscreen, sunglasses, a hat, comfortable clothing, and motion sickness medication if needed. We provide all fishing equipment, bait, and refreshments.
faq.a2: Not at all! Our trips are suitable for beginners and experienced anglers alike. Captain Nikos will provide instructions and assistance throughout the trip.
faq.a3: You can cancel up to 48 hours before your trip for a full refund. Cancellations within 48 hours may be subject to a fee. In case of bad weather, we'll offer a full refund or reschedule.
faq.q4: Are children allowed on the trips?
faq.a4: Yes! Children are welcome on all our trips. We adjust our fishing techniques to make it fun and educational for younger guests.
faq.q5: What happens if it rains on the day of my trip?
faq.a5: We monitor weather conditions closely. If the weather is unsafe, we'll offer to reschedule your trip or provide a full refund. Light rain typically doesn't affect the trip.
faq.q6: How far in advance should I book?
faq.a6: We recommend booking at least 2-3 days in advance to secure your preferred date, especially during peak season (June-August).
faq.q7: Is food included in the trip price?
faq.a7: Basic refreshments are included. You can add a lunch package as an add-on when booking for a fresh local seafood meal.
faq.a8: Our boat can accommodate up to 6 guests, ensuring a personalized and comfortable experience for everyone.
